title: Mouse dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mouse dancing -->
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='18' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='20' y='8' width='2.5' height='12' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='14' r='4' fill='#ff79c6'/>
  <rect x='84' y='4' width='2.5' height='12' fill='#ff79c6'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 78 Q12 78 14 62 Q16 50 26 54' fill='none' stroke='#f4a3c0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#8ea8d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='71' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#c9d8f2'/>
  <!-- left arm waving up -->
  <path d='M34 60 Q22 48 26 38' fill='none' stroke='#8ea8d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#f4a3c0'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M66 60 Q78 56 82 46' fill='none' stroke='#8ea8d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#f4a3c0'/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M42 84 Q40 92 34 94' fill='none' stroke='#8ea8d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 84 Q64 92 70 90' fill='none' stroke='#8ea8d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='95' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f4a3c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='91' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f4a3c0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='18' fill='#8ea8d8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='24' r='9' fill='#8ea8d8'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='25' r='5' fill='#f4a3c0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='24' r='9' fill='#8ea8d8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='25' r='5' fill='#f4a3c0'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e8eef9'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#2b2b3d'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#2b2b3d'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='34' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#ff79c6'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M36 42 L24 39 M36 46 L24 47' stroke='#c9d8f2' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 42 L76 39 M64 46 L76 47' stroke='#c9d8f2' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 50 Q50 54 55 50' fill='none' stroke='#2b2b3d' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
